title: Pages Asociados
description: pages.com.ve Pages Asociados C.A. is a Venezuelan engineering and consulting firm founded in 1972 in Caracas with over 52 years of experience in civil, structural, mechanical and electrical engineering. It operates its own geotechnical and materials testing laboratory, covering soil mechanics, concrete, asphalt and steel testing alongside field investigation services. With offices in Caracas, Maracaibo, Puerto Ordaz and Barinas, it serves the oil and gas, transport, energy and industrial sectors across Venezuela. Key projects include oil terminals for PDVSA, highways, bridges, hydropower plants and port infrastructure. Led by the Pages family across multiple generations, it employs around 200 to 500 engineers and technicians depending on project load. Key strengths are 52 years of market presence, in-house laboratory capabilities and full-service engineering from design through construction supervision and project management.
